architecture_summary: Modular React app. One page component per Stitch screen. Shared UI components extracted from card showcase. React Router v6 for navigation. Tailwind CSS for styling. No state management (local state only).

tickets.title: Create shared UI components from card showcase
tickets.description: Extract reusable components (buttons, cards, progress bars, avatars) from card showcase. Style with Tailwind. Export from src/components/.
acceptance_criteria: Props for dynamic content (text, icons, colors, sizes)
Storybook stories optional (ponytail: add when >3 screens use component)
